name: tidyZillow
what_it_holds: R package/scripts to 'tidy' Zillow Research data (ZHVI/ZORI-style CSVs) into long/tidy format for analysis; small utility repo, 2 stars.
why_useful: A reusable tidying utility for Zillow's own published research CSVs (which we can download directly from Zillow's research page) -- saves reshape work if we pull ZORI/ZHVI ourselves, but adds no new data.
time_coverage: whatever Zillow Research vintage is fed in
size_hint: small R utility, no data committed
themes: Long-term rent indices: Zillow ZORI/ZHVI downloaders, Apartment List, Redfin data center, Realtor.com, HUD Fair Market Rents, Census ACS rent, CoStar-like
why_all: A reusable tidying utility for Zillow's own published research CSVs (which we can download directly from Zillow's research page) -- saves reshape work if we pull ZORI/ZHVI ourselves, but adds no new data.

name: us-housing-buy-vs-rent
what_it_holds: R/Shiny interactive app comparing buy-vs-rent cost across US metros using Zillow research data (ZHVI for prices, presumably ZORI for rent); MIT licensed, updated Aug 2026.
why_useful: Working, recently-touched Shiny app pulling Zillow buy-vs-rent metro series; the buy/rent cost gap is a plausible macro driver of household formation and short-vs-long-term rental substitution, but the repo is a live app over Zillow's own feed, not a static dataset.
size_hint: no data committed, live Shiny pulls

name: hud-fair-market-rents-scraper
what_it_holds: An Apify actor (cloud scraper-as-a-service wrapper) for pulling HUD Fair Market Rent data; requires an Apify account/run to get output, no data committed to the repo.
why_useful: Marginal -- just a thin Apify wrapper around HUD's own public FMR data/API, which we could query directly for free without needing Apify.
size_hint: no data committed, Apify actor config only

Housing affordability and STR-housing studies data: rent-burden, vacancy, STR share of housing stock by tract
why_all: Marginal -- just a thin Apify wrapper around HUD's own public FMR data/API, which we could query directly for free without needing Apify.
One-command (Apify run) method to pull current HUD FMR tables if the official bulk download changes format; low value since HUD already publishes bulk CSVs directly.

A packaged, schedulable puller for HUD FMR data if the team wants FMR refreshed on a cadence without hitting the HUD API directly; low marginal value since HUD FMR is already a documented public API (see Zoning-and-Rent-Burdens above), but useful as a ready integration if Apify credentials exist.

name: hud (API Evangelist documentation)
what_it_holds: Documentation/catalogue (not a live client) of HUD's public API surface: Fair Market Rents, income limits, and other housing-affordability APIs, pointing to HUD's own developer portal (data.hud.gov). Last updated 12 Sep 2026, 0 stars.
why_useful: Useful map of what HUD actually exposes via API (endpoints, coverage) to plan a direct pull rather than scraping — low novelty as data but saves discovery time.
themes: Long-term rent indices: Zillow ZORI/ZHVI downloaders, Apartment List, Redfin data center, Realtor.com, HUD Fair Market Rents, Census ACS rent, CoStar-like
